literal_meaning: থোক বা একসাথে মূল্য নির্ধারণের পদ্ধতি (wholesale or bundled pricing method)
figurative_meaning_en: Approximately, by rough estimate, at a lump sum or wholesale price
example_sentences_in_bangla: থাউকো হিসাবে মোট খরচ গণনা করো।
example_sentences_in_english: I bought it at a wholesale price.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali market practices where goods are sold in bulk without precise measurement.
